title: Exponential Periods for Integrals in Physics
summary: The study of Feynman integrals through the lens of intersection theory offers a unifying framework for their analysis, capturing both the linear and quadratic relations that arise among integrals. In doing so, it provides a powerful method for systematically reducing them to the so called master integrals, a necessary strategy for multiloop contributions, whose huge number make direct calculation unfeasible.
